notes: All 27 source and 32 target IDs partitioned exactly once.
The three σῷ ὀνόματι phrases are analysed alike — article unrepresented, *thy* on the possessive adjective, *by name* on the noun (rules 20, 21, 24, 54).

δυνάμεις → *mighty works* heads on *mighty*: *works* is the generic completion and the ASV's own gloss note *Greek powers* shows which word carries the lexeme (rules 66, 91). Heading on *works* is named in that unit's note as the competing reading.
The do-support of the question is spent on the first verb, so ἐποιήσαμεν takes a bare *do*, matching MAT.7.16's treatment of *Do* (rule 24).
